name: Chi Kan Holdings Limited
summary: Chi Kan Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provision of formwork and other construction services in Hong Kong and e-commerce business in the People's Republic of China. It provides timber and plywood conventional formwork, and aluminum and steel prefabricated framework. Chi Kan Holdings Limited was formerly known as Chi Kan Woodworks Company Limited. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong.
